## Final evidence edition: deployment value and the limit of succession

Completed the bounded continuation and prepared additive draft source PR **#4938**, head `8e45aaa85b4b147b9c585303565dede1364e6476`, in `studies/agi-alpha-game-theoretic-economics-v1/`. Existing publications, owners, runtime, canonical ledger, held execution and currency boundaries remain intact. No merge or release qualification is claimed.

**Original results preserved exactly.** The primary and exploratory failures remain primary/exploratory. The original $20 diagnostic still gives prospective B mean profit **$183.28**, mean B−A **$184.97**, and full-history B mean **−$178.24** across twelve paired worlds. Its workload, zero integration, ten avoided provider minutes and logit choice remain explicit assumptions. B continues to tie the conventional builder.

**Separately registered extension completed.** Freeze comment 6422814875 preceded all 128 conditions × 24 fresh seeds. The same 52-week horizon, $1,000 opening resources, $200 reserve and unchanged core were retained. The original bounded invocation finished at 17:27:04 UTC within its CPU/wall and 18:10:33 cutoff limits.

At the selected policy's fresh reference, prospective B mean profit is **$151.70**, paired gain **$173.67**, with **3/24 losing paths**, before unpriced incremental discovery cost D. Nonzero integration, lower recurrence, upkeep, delay, competitor policies and another buyer model expose the limits. No full-history condition has positive mean profit or paired gain; **22 individual full-history worlds nevertheless have both positive**. All conditions and failed paths remain visible.

**Generated resources are distinct from full repayment.** Predeclared seed 3001 collects $720 and incurs $369 prospective costs, leaving a **$351 generated-resource ceiling before D**, with obligations and reserve protected. The once-charged historical allowance leaves full-history profit **−$10.52**. The second-capability gate examined three burdens and returned **NO-GO before construction**: no qualified actual successor, prototype, purchase or hypothetical savings. Seed funding is legitimate; a second productive financing cycle is not established.

The finished delivery includes the 27-page LaTeX/PDF, offline English/French laboratory, four actual packets, all **9,552 paired worlds / 28,656 enterprise histories**, complete competitor accounts, source manifests and preserved failures. The complete companion has 1,934 payload files and SHA-256:
`f47d830b095f33e17cda62b7516b49cd099c1745be8dd4e99bdcd4c658e3a2fa`.

It passed CRC, complete extraction, payload/source hashes and a separate clean-extraction review. A first review's unmatched external temporary prefix file was left untouched and documented; identical strict checks passed on a separate fresh extraction. The large companion is supplied separately in two exact verified parts, whose tested restoration reproduces that same ZIP hash. The public Git subset explicitly does not contain all large histories/wheels.

Final claims review passed 33 closure checks; the new non-monotone competition/payment mechanisms passed 615 independent archival assertions. The bilingual demo passed 38 browser checks; standalone TeX rebuilt with identical text. These are same-session reviews, not external certification. Hosted repository checks remain separate and unclaimed. Actual customer receipts, financial transactions and second investments are all zero.
